name: Material Volume Calculator
description: Calculate material volume from mass and density, or find the mass from known volume.

seo.title: Material Volume Calculator - Mass to Volume
seo.description: Material Volume Calculator — Calculate material volume from mass and density, or find the mass from known volume with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Volume = Mass / Density. Mass in kg, density in kg/m³; × 10⁹ converts m³ to mm³ for convenient display.

content.introduction: Calculate the volume of a material given its mass and density. Useful for casting, molding, and material displacement calculations.

example.description: 78.5 kg of carbon steel occupies 0.01 m³ = 10,000,000 mm³ (a 100mm × 100mm × 1000mm bar).

faq.q: How do I convert mass to volume?
faq.a: Volume = Mass / Density. For example, 1 kg of aluminum (2700 kg/m³) = 0.00037 m³ = 0.37 liters.
Casting volume estimation, material displacement (Archimedes), tank fill calculations, and 3D printing material estimation.
